plain_text:
"Schedules are useful in that they help create a routine
and give them something to look forward to," Dr. Lewis
said. "When you're able to create a schedule and you
know what's upcoming, that can help you to manage
stress and anxiety by minimizing the unknown."

fun and relaxation!

or text 800-985-5990. This service is confidential
and multilingual.
